testing_and_data_attributes.mandatory_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build a sleek mobile-first PWA container with a high-end dark/light theme engine (using next-themes or explicit class toggle).
2. Ensure zero text collision by using tight hairline borders ('border border-white/10 dark:border-white/10 border-slate-200 light:border-slate-200') and adequate padding ('p-4 md:p-6').
3. Implement mock multi-source news aggregator state (Finnhub, NewsAPI, Alpha Vantage badges) with filtering by topic, search query, and impact score.

4. Deliver all key features from user prompt: Level 1 (Flash cards with title + 3 bullets), Impact Score 1-10, Effetto Domino interactive drawer, Sector Tags, Level 2 Modal deep dive with 'Chiedi all'IA', Bottom Nav with 4 tabs, Market Widgets (S&P500, NASDAQ, FTSE MIB, Gold, Oil, BTC), Big Tech financial balance sheet previews, Geopolitical Radar map/list, 'La Storia Insegna' parallel cards, AI Copilot with Gemini chat, and 'Accadde oggi' daily history pill.
5. Use exact data-testid attributes listed in the guidelines for seamless E2E verifiability.
6. Ensure code structure uses React .js files and standard imports.
